violations.reason: In tests/accessibility/theme-contrast.test.ts, RuntimeThemeManager and themeVariants fake runtime theme switching and token contrast verification using an in-test mock fixture class and hardcoded slate palette tested against WCAG AA (4.5:1), rather than testing the real DesignTokenCompiler and verifying the client-mandated WCAG AAA (7:1) contrast with Obsidian tokens (#08090C, #11141C).
